text.facebook: Why do big dogs age faster? A study of 864 dogs, published in Science this week, found giant breeds lose about 35% more of the chemical tags that keep 'jumping genes' in check each year than small breeds. PDSA says dogs are senior at about seven on average, but it varies with size. My tip: with a big dog, don't wait for the grey muzzle. Try shorter, more frequent walks on flatter ground. More here: https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/big-dogs-age-faster
